In this algorithm, the quantum state of the input qubit in quantum line 1 is "teleported" to the output qubit in quantum line 3.
Modify the quantum state of the input qubit by double-clicking on it.
Perform 2 partial measurements by double-clicking on the measurements of lines 1 and 2.
The state of the input qubit is then "teleported" to the qubit in line 3.
